states.message: Welcome to Auction and recovery! Please select a topic you would like to learn about.
When a loan crosses its due date without renewal or repayment, the system flags it overdue and an initial reminder notice is sent to the customer.
Before auctioning, at least two notices must be sent to the borrower, giving reasonable advance notice (typically around 30 days) and the auction must also be publicly advertised.
Auctions must be conducted transparently with a fair reserve price based on the current gold rate — never auction below reserve, and maintain an auction register.
After the loan and charges are recovered from the auction proceeds, any surplus must be returned to the borrower — the branch cannot keep excess proceeds.
